summary: AI BRAWL Phase 2 full regression: backend + frontend polish (intro overlay, pause via controls mid-fight, small-viewport gate, matchup swap, character cards). Backend 3/3 pytest pass. Frontend 44/44 Playwright assertions pass including STEP 1/STEP 2 layout, disabled FIGHT gating, all 4 close methods for the controls modal (X/Escape/backdrop/RESUME), intro overlay READY→FIGHT! transition, timer & HP frozen during intro, mid-fight pause freezes timer, resume decrements timer, topbar-exit returns to select, fresh intro on new TITAN vs WRAITH matchup (140/140 & 100/100), mirror match (VOLT vs VOLT), and small-viewport gate at 600px.

issues: Recurring browser warning: Canvas2D getImageData without willReadFrequently=true. Perf hint only — pass {willReadFrequently:true} to getContext('2d') in renderer.js to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: Renderer still triggers Canvas2D willReadFrequently perf warning (carried from Phase 1). Cheap fix: canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }).
GameCanvas.jsx has two independent Escape listeners (one in GameCanvas, one in ControlsOverlay). Harmless today but could clash if more shortcuts are added — consolidate.

REMATCH (data-testid=restart-button) and CHANGE FIGHTERS (data-testid=exit-button) exist in ResultOverlay code path but weren't exercised end-to-end since forcing a KO in a 60s round is flaky; validated equivalent 'fresh state on new fight' via topbar-exit + new matchup as suggested by the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 verified 100%. Result overlay REMATCH/CHANGE FIGHTERS buttons still not exercised via real KO (60s round too long). To test in future: either shorten round timer via engine config, expose a debug hook to set HP=0, or programmatically call engineRef.current._endMatch(). Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py; frontend tested with Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
